source: Live GraphQL calls, response headers and timings, 2026-10-13; https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting
statement: Linear charged X-Complexity 12 for one request holding a project's board (61 issues, first: 250) and backlog (100 issues); the response headers give an API key 2,500 requests and 3,000,000 complexity points an hour (x-ratelimit-requests-limit, x-ratelimit-complexity-limit). The board query alone took about 170 ms, the board with the backlog about 215 ms (medians of 6).
